method: Production physics/collisions/NPC AI unchanged. Observations expose planner closures. Counterfactual changes only one selected route at 6.483333s to [1,2,3], retaining production controls, rolling revalidation and all real dynamics.

rejectionAudit.definition: A production-decision candidate passed safePath, is collision-free for all 3.6s, predicts more physical progress than staying, but fails the unchanged score threshold. Consecutive qualifying production decisions are joined only with the same target and <=0.35s separation; spans are observed spans, not proof for unobserved frames.
